title: Can Claude replace Rocketlane? 28/28 checks, 18 spec gaps #shorts
description:
Claude built a Rocketlane alternative, a client onboarding tracker with a checklist for every stage and a hard gate between stages, from one written spec: all 28 acceptance checks passed, and the build exposed 18 gaps in the spec.

Full build test (2:45): https://youtu.be/8o02hhUDQ5s
The free spec: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/blueprints/client-onboarding-tracker
Rocketlane pricing and alternatives: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/alternatives/rocketlane

Rocketlane lists Standard at $49 and Premium at $69 per team member per month, billed annually, each with a minimum of 5 team members; Enterprise is custom (rocketlane.com/pricing, October 2026).

Made with AI: Sam's on-camera hook and outro are an AI avatar of him, and the narration is his AI voice clone (HeyGen). The product footage is from the real test build.
